id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1387: "In this trade, town rumors and information naturally reach me. You saved the town, didn't you?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1396: "Mr. Rotondo's judgment wasn't clouded. You, his benefactor, are now the whole town's benefactor.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1418: "Everyone's giddy that the town was saved and their purse strings have loosened. So...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|151f: "The plaza's noisy... Could one of the Dark One's minions have appeared? If so, how terrifying...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1531: "This is Gondolia. Far fewer people now and it's lonely, but everyone's working hard to bring back the life!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|153c: "Oh, and the folks from the seabed seem to like this town... Now they've blended right in!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|154f: "Wow, maybe because the Dark One's beaten, even the wind through town feels great! Peace is wonderful!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|155a: "Anyway... this is Gondolia. Far fewer people now and it's lonely, but everyone's working hard to bring back the life!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1578: "Goodness, I can say this line again. I can't sleep with my feet toward the Luminary who saved the town.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|165c: "Ah, delicious... Three meals a day of nothing but cake has been my dream since childhood.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1668: "I hear the Dark One will soon destroy the world, so I don't mind getting fat! I'll savor cake to the very end.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1679: "I'm sampling the owner's new cake, but it's odd... it's somehow salty.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1688: "When the monsters attacked I worried constantly that this cake shop would be destroyed.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1693: "But I'm glad it's safe. I can eat this shop's cake again... ah, bliss.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16a0: "Not just Gondolia, I hear every town is troubled, so I think I'll settle here a while.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17d8: "Oh, are you here for cake? Sorry, we're about to close. Please come again.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|188b: "Just like everyone's saying, you saved the town, didn't you? Thanks... I'm grateful.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1911: "When monsters attacked, Mr. Rotondo stayed in town to the end to evacuate us.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|191d: "Seeing him fulfill his duty as mayor, I was thrilled to the core. I decided to follow him for life.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19b0: "I heard a golden-glowing iceberg appeared off the coast of the northern kingdom, Sniflheim.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19bc: "Strange things have happened everywhere since Yggdrasil fell, so I worry about the people of Sniflheim.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19cd: "Those fish-like people came up from an undersea kingdom, I hear. A kingdom beautiful as paradise.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19db: "I was stunned that a kingdom exists beneath the sea. The world really is wide!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19ea: "I stopped in town on my way back from a deal and got caught in the monster attack. I ran for my life.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19fa: "I'd just satisfied my customer and felt good about finishing the job, and then this. What a disaster.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a60: "I heard from that informant. You saved this town, they say.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a68: "I should tell those who don't know yet. The one who saved Gondolia is the Luminary, {var:1}!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ad6: "When monsters attacked the town I was drunk... But someone seems to have saved me.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ae2: "You could've left a drunk like me alone. ...There are some grateful people out there.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ba0: "I left Puerto Valor and stopped in this town, only to run into a monster attack of all times.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bbd: "I left Puerto Valor and stopped in this town, only to run into a monster attack of all times.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bac: "I got through thanks to a merchant's instinct... no, with such instinct I'd never have met the attack.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bc9: "I got through thanks to a merchant's instinct... no, with such instinct I'd never have met the attack.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c76: "Monsters attacking a town! I should've gone to Puerto Valor sooner instead of dawdling!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c82: "But we're safe now, so surely it's fine to relax a bit longer.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c99: "She's sleeping quietly now, but until recently she was so scared she couldn't sleep.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d35: "So many monsters attacked, I was really scared... I clung to Mama and bawled.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1de6: "My skilled sailor friends all went out to sea and haven't come back.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1df0: "Only slowpokes like me remain... how ironic. Sob, hic.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dfc: "My sailor friends who sailed out still haven't returned... but I believe they'll come back.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e08: "I'm still a green sailor, but while everyone's away, I have to support this harbor!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e2d: "Work was tough again today, but I'll do my best for my mother back home. I'll never give up!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ea4: "The monster attack wrecked our loading schedule!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eab: "Hey, rookie! Quit slacking! At this pace the sun'll set before we finish!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eba: "A sailor's body is his capital. Drink well, eat well, build stamina. Though I ate a bit too much...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f74: "Mayor Rotondo is reliable. His guidance this time kept the losses to a minimum.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f92: "Mayor Rotondo is reliable. His guidance this time kept the losses to a minimum.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f82: "Heliodor won't be glaring at us anymore, so I hope Mr. Rotondo stays mayor forever.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fa0: "Heliodor won't be glaring at us anymore, so I hope Mr. Rotondo stays mayor forever.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2045: "A survivor says the Dark One sent a sea-ruling monster that surfaces and vanishes into the rain...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2059: "Hard to believe, but a monster that holds the wide sea must have fearsome power.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|206b: "Those fish-like folks from the seabed... why are they fine on land? Did they originally live on land...?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2078: "I wondered and asked to examine their bodies, but they flatly refused. Sigh...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|208d: "With the Kraken and now this violent monster army, the world's laws seem to have gone mad.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|209d: "I've checked old records but none mention this! Ah... not understanding is terrifying!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20e6: "Ooh... that was really scary. Lots of monsters came to town and I ran for my life...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20f3: "That I can relax like this is thanks to the Luminary who saved the town... I'm very grateful.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2160: "When the town was attacked, that man took my hand and ran with me.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|216b: "As a former soldier, his body moves on its own in a crisis. He saved my life.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|217d: "The world lately is tangled like hemp. I never get a moment's peace.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2188: "The Luminary's power got rid of the monsters again, but what happens next time...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2227: "...Hm? Who are you? After Yggdrasil fell, I traveled around and saw the world's ruin with my own eyes!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2236: "Along the way I saw so much sorrow... Expressing it in paintings is my calling!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2245: "Now you understand? You're disturbing my work! Out, out!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2270: "Now you understand? You're disturbing my work! Out, out!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2252: "...Hm? Who are you? I'm at a good part. The painting I've worked on for so long is almost done!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|225e: "After Yggdrasil fell, I traveled around and saw the world's ruin with my own eyes. Now that painting will be finished!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|227e: "...I can paint! I can paint now! I can send out my finest work to shake the art world!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|228d: "I'll title it Hero of the Sea City! Ah! I want to carve the Luminary who saved this town onto the canvas right now!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|229a: "...Hey, I'm about to concentrate to sharpen my image. You're a bother, go somewhere else!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|231a: "Oh, do you need something at this house? A painter lived here, living off his old fortune.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|232a: "But after Yggdrasil fell, he believed painting the ruined world as it is was his duty and set out.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|233b: "I don't know when he'll return, but I'll keep guarding this house until he does.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|234c: "Oh, a visitor. The master who went traveling has returned... I'm so happy.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2357: "...Not that I'm happy he's safe. Without an employer, there's no pay.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|236a: "Oh, a visitor. The painting the master has long worked on is finally nearly done.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2376: "Actually, this is the first time I'll see one of his paintings truly finished. I can't wait!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|238b: "My master just groans like that and his brush won't move at all.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2395: "He says he can't paint a masterpiece until the urge to paint grows. What a hopeless man.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2439: "Ever since the Seafarer Contest day, Heliodor soldiers came, then monsters. I've had enough!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2445: "Never before has the town been like this... What on earth is going on?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24c1: "This is Gondolia. It used to be a beautiful port town thriving on trade, but now people are fewer and it's lonely.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24cf: "Monsters rule the sea, so trade is out of the question.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24dc: "This is Gondolia. Far fewer people than before, but we're working to get back to normal.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24e8: "Come to think of it, those from the seabed seem to like this town and have settled in.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24f9: "That bastard Jasper. Darkspawn? Don't make me laugh.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2500: "Far from a Darkspawn, you were this town's savior! No amount of thanks is enough.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|257a: "This year has been nothing but trouble. The town's always in a commotion, I can't set up my stall in peace.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26a1: "Back then monsters flooded the canals, streets, even rooftops. It was truly terrifying...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2718: "I used to long for Puerto Valor, but when monsters attacked Gondolia I realized I love this town.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2726: "Ah, I'm so glad you're safe... The usual Gondolia is back.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27b1: "To celebrate the monsters being gone, Real, the town's favorite seafarer, put on a show on stage!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27be: "The town is nearly back to normal. Peaceful Gondolia is back in our hands!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2868: "They show no sign of attacking so far, but we don't know what they might do. I'm watching carefully.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2875: "If they bare their fangs, I'll protect Mr. Rotondo and the rest. I won't let them do as they please here.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2884: "To command the town's two top seafarers like that... that man from the sea is no ordinary person...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2897: "Until the Luminary saved the town, I just kept running from monsters. I avoided following my parents.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28a5: "It'd be unforgivable to lose the life my parents left me to monsters...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|298c: "I evacuated with my child. Driven out of town by a huge number of monsters, I felt more dead than alive.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29a1: "I evacuated with my child. Driven out of town by a huge number of monsters, I felt more dead than alive.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a69: "Traveler, it's terrible! A strange creature came up from the sea and there's a huge uproar!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a75: "The strange creature's in the north plaza! It might be dangerous, so for your own good, stay away!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a84: "A strange creature came up from the sea and the north plaza is in an uproar! What if it's dangerous...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a95: "That strange creature from the sea... doesn't seem to be doing anything so far. Why did it come?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aa4: "The sea's calming down and ships can go out little by little. Soon the evacuated townsfolk will come back!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2abf: "Even I thought it was over this time, so I was worried about you all.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bea: "Dear god... please calm the raging sea...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bf6: "Dear god... thank you for calming the turmoil...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c02: "Dear god... thank you for restoring a peaceful world...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c11: "I hear the one who saved Gondolia was the Darkspawn... no, the Luminary, but I can't recall his face.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c2f: "I hear the one who saved Gondolia was the Darkspawn... no, the Luminary, but I can't recall his face.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c1f: "But he's the Luminary. He must be a handsome man with a kind, loving smile.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c3d: "But he's the Luminary. He must be a handsome man with a kind, loving smile.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cd5: "The Seafarer Contest is finally starting! I'm so excited I could dance!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ce0: "Ah, Mr. Cowdell's lovely voice is great, and Mr. Real's strong physique too... I can't decide who to cheer for!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d0f: "Those people... look pale and have fins on their heads! They look like fish!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d1d: "They say these people came from the seabed. No wonder they have fish faces!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d29: "The town's two top seafarers seem moved by that man's words. What on earth are they talking about...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d3b: "Ah, to hear Mr. Cowdell's singing here again. I never dreamed of it when monsters attacked!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d49: "No amount of thanks is enough for the Luminary who saved the town.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d58: "What is that creature... I've never even heard rumors of anything that looks like that!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d68: "Apparently that rumored monster Jarvis rampaged not just on the sea but under it too. What a terrible brute...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d78: "The three from the sea... I first thought them odd creatures. Fishy smell aside, they're really good folks.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2de0: "A fish-like person suddenly came out of the sea. Wow, I was stunned!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2de9: "Come to think of it, I heard strange things happen at the inn in Champs Sauvages too. What has become of this world?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dfb: "More than us, these people seem to be suffering from Jarvis, the monster the Dark One sent.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e09: "I'd like to help, but we're doing all we can ourselves.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e18: "Look at Master's fishing stance. Unmoving and dignified, like a catfish hiding in sand.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e23: "...Who's Master? Obviously the one fishing next to me, who came from the undersea kingdom.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e2f: "Master fishes every day, they say. Fishing on the seabed with a fish-like face, that's the coolest.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e42: "I worried the monster attack had ruined the fishing spot, but it seems fine. Good.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e4f: "I can fish as usual again. Repeating days are good.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ef7: "Since Yggdrasil fell, customers who say 'if the world's ending anyway, I'll eat cake till I die' never stop coming.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f06: "That might not matter, but cake is all I can make, so I'll do what I can.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f16: "I had guests from the sea try our cake, and the opinion was that it needs more salt.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f23: "I'm researching cake for them now. Sweets for non-human guests is a new challenge! I'm excited again!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f38: "To celebrate the town's liberation, everyone's ordering cake. We're swamped!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f45: "A real patissier's joy. Never since becoming a craftsman have people enjoyed our cake this much!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f53: "With this many customers, I get to flex my patissier skills, but it's a bit hard on the body...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ff9: "This is the cake shop counter. If you need the item shop, please go to the first floor.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3006: "Sorry, our cakes are sold out. If you need the item shop, not us, please go to the first floor.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3091: "I planned a vacation in Puerto Valor with my darling, but I put it off for a while.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|309c: "We finally got back to our own home, so I'll wait until things calm down a bit more.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31bc: "We're playing hide-and-seek! Don't talk to me, they'll find me!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3211: "My sister said once the monsters left town, let's continue hide-and-seek, all of a sudden.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|321d: "She hid before I could say no. Where could she have gone? I can't find her at all.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3234: "Rotondo's son Placido, young master, inheriting his father's blood, grew into such a kind, clever boy.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3241: "That boy will surely take over from his father and become a fine merchant.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|328f: "If Mr. Rotondo hadn't hidden the Luminary from Jasper back then, this town would've been destroyed by monsters.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|329b: "Thanks to Mr. Rotondo we avoided Champs Sauvages's and Dundrasil's fate. Bless him, bless him...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|330f: "The Luminary, once called the Darkspawn, saved this town.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3319: "The Luminary must have felt indebted to Mr. Rotondo, who helped when Heliodor soldiers chased him.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|333a: "Put this crate on your ship and it protects you from storms, they say! Get your crate here! Crates, anyone?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3446: "Attacked by a terrible monster of the Dark One, many merchant ships were sunk to the seabed... Countless sailors are missing.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3458: "According to survivors, it's huge like a black mountain and appears with a violent storm.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3469: "I hear the three from the sea are brothers, but thirty years apart in age. Their sense of time differs from ours.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|347b: "I hear the three from the sea are brothers, but thirty years apart in age. Their sense of time differs from ours.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3517: "Every house is empty. The residents here all evacuated. It makes little difference where they flee.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3528: "The sea's calming down, so evacuees will come back when the time is right. The drink's good and it's a nice town.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35f7: "Why, it's the Luminary! I'm glad you're safe. You've returned entirely to human form.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3603: "We, people of the undersea kingdom, were attacked by Jarvis, the Dark One's minion, and barely escaped.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3635: "We, people of the undersea kingdom, were attacked by Jarvis, the Dark One's minion, and barely escaped.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3612: "All life in the sea was reaped and the sea fell under Jarvis's rule. We no longer have a place...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3644: "All life in the sea was reaped and the sea fell under Jarvis's rule. We no longer have a place...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3675: "All life in the sea was reaped and the sea fell under Jarvis's rule. We no longer have a place...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3696: "All life in the sea was reaped and the sea fell under Jarvis's rule. We no longer have a place...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3667: "Luminary! I'm glad you're safe! ...We were attacked by Jarvis and barely escaped our undersea kingdom.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3683: "Luminary... please! Defeat Jarvis and save the sea! Restore the sea as it was!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36a4: "Luminary... please! Defeat Jarvis and save the sea! Restore the sea as it was!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36bb: "You see... in the end, a neighbor is a friend, a teacher, and sometimes food. That's a passage from the Seabed Teachings...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|370d: "You see... in the end, a neighbor is a friend, a teacher, and sometimes food. That's a passage from the Seabed Teachings...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36c9: "...Gasp, Luminary, when did you arrive! We fled Jarvis to this town, and we like it, so we're staying.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36d7: "Since I finally met humans, I'm now telling this town's seafarers the Seabed Teachings.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3725: "Since I finally met humans, I'm now telling this town's seafarers the Seabed Teachings.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36e5: "The sea seems to be recovering. Luminary, thank you so much for defeating Jarvis!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36f6: "You see... in the end, a neighbor is a friend, a teacher, and sometimes food. That's a passage from the Seabed Teachings...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|371b: "...Gasp, Luminary!! You finally beat the Dark One! Thank you so much!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3733: "This town has a traditional Seafarer Contest, I hear. The Seabed Teachings would help a lot there.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|374e: "Ow... damn. I was attacked by a guy called Jarvis in the east sea and barely escaped.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3759: "I got separated from my friends while fleeing. Just one thing after another. If you head east, be careful.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|378b: "...Gasp, Luminary, when did you arrive. I can catch fish here I've never seen on the seabed, so I'll stay ashore a while.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3799: "Thanks to you beating Jarvis, the hidden fish seem to be showing up. Thanks for restoring the sea.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37ac: "I haven't fished in a while. But they say even a rotten sea bream... My fishing skill's still alive!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37be: "...Gasp, Luminary!! You finally beat the Dark One! You really did it, as expected!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37ca: "The fish I caught flopped with joy at the Dark One's fall! Truly a cause for celebration! Thanks!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37e2: "Gulp gulp... Jarvis is scary. He's so big and tries to gulp us down.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37f2: "Phew... Then this is safer than the sea. Jarvis is there so we can't live in the sea anymore...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3800: "N-no way, we escaped the sea Jarvis rampages in, so don't scare us! Shiver.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3810: "A sea where snow falls... a place where a pillar of light stands... Jarvis must be rampaging there...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|381c: "...Luminary, please! Beat Jarvis! Bring peace back to the sea!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3829: "You know, I'm not human, but Rad and Placido play with me!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3831: "Humans eat fish, so I was a bit scared... but everyone's so kind!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|383f: "Gulp gulp. I've never eaten human food before, it's all new and so delicious! I'll eat plenty!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3849: "...But between us, with a bit more salt it might be even tastier... Gulp gulp.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|398f: "I see... Of course. It can't be found so easily. It's all right... I understand.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cfd: "There's no one else to ask, and I'm sorry to that mermaid, but she'll have to give up...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41c9: "Oh, big brother! Thank you so much for saving Daddy the other day!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41e5: "Ugh... Daddy won't run away at all, even with a scary dragon around.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41ed: "But I can't take my eyes off him either... Maybe this is the informant blood stirring...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41fb: "The people in this village can't do anything without Miko.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4202: "...Connie has no mommy either, but I can do things myself. Connie's not a kid anymore!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4210: "The steam bath here feels so good! The drink called egg sake is said to be delicious too.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4218: "Oh! Big brother! Daddy found a guide job. Connie's helping too!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|422f: "Oh! Big brother! You beat the Dark One! Connie's so happy!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|423f: "Big brother, you're amazing! You beat all those bad guys!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4285: "Oh, we meet again! Remember, the genius informant Noah who told you about Yggdrasil's branch!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42d7: "Oh, we meet again! Remember, the genius informant Noah who told you about Yggdrasil's branch!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4291: "This area wasn't affected by Yggdrasil's fall and the villagers were kind, so I stayed here with Connie, but...

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42e4: "This area wasn't affected by Yggdrasil's fall and the villagers were kind, so I stayed here with Connie, but...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4306: "This area wasn't affected by Yggdrasil's fall and the villagers were kind, so I stayed here with Connie, but...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4327: "Oh, you saw it too...! A fire dragon suddenly appeared and swallowed the priestess whole!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4334: "Wow, I saw something amazing...! Bad timing, but my informant blood is stirring.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4346: "You're really something. You downed the fire dragon the village's strongest priestess couldn't beat.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4354: "Going after the fire dragon that fled to the volcano? Now's the chance to finish it, but the volcano road is locked.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4364: "The gate key is held by Miko, the priestess's attendant. She'll hand it over to you.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4375: "Going to the volcano after the fled fire dragon? With the key you can pass the gate on the mountain road next door west.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4384: "Now's the chance to finish it. With your strength it's easy, right? Go beat it in a flash.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4397: "Hey, {var:1}. I can't leave here for a while, so I've become this village's guide.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43e9: "Hey, {var:1}. I can't leave here for a while, so I've become this village's guide.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43a1: "Perfect for a genius informant, right? Though working for tourists takes some getting used to. Ha ha!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43f2: "Perfect for a genius informant, right? Though working for tourists takes some getting used to. Ha ha!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43b5: "Hey, {var:1}. What's up, want to ask something?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4406: "Hey, {var:1}. What's up, want to ask something?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43c2: "I see. Fine then. Whenever you want to rely on the genius informant Noah, come to this village anytime.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4414: "I see. Fine then. Whenever you want to rely on the genius informant Noah, come to this village anytime.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43d2: "A forge inside Mount Huji? Never heard of one, but the shrine people may know.

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4438: "Hey, {var:1}, I heard. There's a legendary forge in the forbidden grounds at Mount Huji's summit.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4458: "Hey, {var:1}, I heard. There's a legendary forge in the forbidden grounds at Mount Huji's summit.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4446: "Even I haven't been to the forbidden grounds. The summit means the crater, right? Don't you fall in...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4466: "Even I haven't been to the forbidden grounds. The summit means the crater, right? Don't you fall in...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|447a: "Hey, {var:1}, I heard. You finally beat the Dark One, Mordegon!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44a4: "Hey, {var:1}, I heard. You finally beat the Dark One, Mordegon!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4484: "I couldn't watch your fight with him, but the rumor reached here loud and clear!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44ae: "I couldn't watch your fight with him, but the rumor reached here loud and clear!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4490: "...But I don't see that little red-hooded girl who once helped me. Say hi to her for me.

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44cd: "This is bad. Since that black sun appeared, monsters turned violent and seized Gondolia!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44dd: "The townsfolk evacuated before the attack, but monsters settled in. Damn, strutting around like they own it...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44ee: "Hey, you can beat them, right? Defeat every monster in town and bring peace back to Gondolia!

tm.「こんな家業だから 町のウワサと情報は\n 自然と オレの所まで 集まってくる。: "In this trade, town rumors and information naturally reach me. You saved the town, didn't you?
tm.「ラハディオさんの目は くもっちゃいなかった。\n あの人の恩人だった あんたが: "Mr. Rotondo's judgment wasn't clouded. You, his benefactor, are now the whole town's benefactor.
tm.「みんな 町が救われて うかれてるのか\n 財布のヒモが ゆるくなってるみたいな: "Everyone's giddy that the town was saved and their purse strings have loosened. So...
tm.「広場の方が 騒がしいですが……\n まさか 魔王の手下が現れたのでしょうか？\: "The plaza's noisy... Could one of the Dark One's minions have appeared? If so, how terrifying...
tm.「ここは ダーハルーネの町。\n ずいぶん 人も減って さみしいものですが\n: "This is Gondolia. Far fewer people now and it's lonely, but everyone's working hard to bring back the life!
tm.「そうそう 海の底からやってきた方々が\n この町を気に入ってくれたようでして…: "Oh, and the folks from the seabed seem to like this town... Now they've blended right in!
tm.「いや～ 魔王が倒されたおかげか\n 町を吹きぬける風も 気持ちいいですねっ！\: "Wow, maybe because the Dark One's beaten, even the wind through town feels great! Peace is wonderful!
tm.「それはそうと……ここは ダーハルーネの町。\n ずいぶん 人も減って さみしい: "Anyway... this is Gondolia. Far fewer people now and it's lonely, but everyone's working hard to bring back the life!
tm.「いやはや また このセリフを言えるとは。\n 町を救ってくださったという 勇者: "Goodness, I can say this line again. I can't sleep with my feet toward the Luminary who saved the town.
tm.「ああ おいしいですわ……。\n １日３食 ひたすらケーキづくし……というのが\: "Ah, delicious... Three meals a day of nothing but cake has been my dream since childhood.
tm.「もうすぐ 魔王が世界をほろぼすと 聞きますし\n 太ったって かまいませんわ！: "I hear the Dark One will soon destroy the world, so I don't mind getting fat! I'll savor cake to the very end.
tm.「ここの店主さんの 新作のケーキを\n ためしに いただいてるのですけれど\n: "I'm sampling the owner's new cake, but it's odd... it's somehow salty.
tm.「魔物が襲ってきたとき ここのケーキ屋が\n 壊されてしまったら どうしようって: "When the monsters attacked I worried constantly that this cake shop would be destroyed.
tm.「でも 無事でよかった。\n こうして このお店のケーキが\n 食べられるんだも: "But I'm glad it's safe. I can eat this shop's cake again... ah, bliss.
tm.「ダーハルーネの町に限らず\n どこの町も きな臭いって聞くし\n しばらくの間: "Not just Gondolia, I hear every town is troubled, so I think I'll settle here a while.
tm.「おや ケーキを買いにきたのかい？\n ごめんよ もう 閉店するところなんだ。\: "Oh, are you here for cake? Sorry, we're about to close. Please come again.
tm.「みんなが ウワサしてる通り\n あんたたちが 町を救ってくれたんだろう？\n: "Just like everyone's saying, you saved the town, didn't you? Thanks... I'm grateful.
tm.「魔物が町を襲ったとき ラハディオさんが\n あたしたちを 避難させるために\n: "When monsters attacked, Mr. Rotondo stayed in town to the end to evacuate us.
tm.「町長としての 責任を果たそうとした姿に\n あたしゃ 心底しびれてね……。\n: "Seeing him fulfill his duty as mayor, I was thrilled to the core. I decided to follow him for life.
tm.「北の王国 クレイモランの近海で\n こがね色にかがやく 氷山が現れた……\n: "I heard a golden-glowing iceberg appeared off the coast of the northern kingdom, Sniflheim.
tm.「大樹が落ちてから 各地で異変が起きていますし\n クレイモラン王国の人々が 心: "Strange things have happened everywhere since Yggdrasil fell, so I worry about the people of Sniflheim.
tm.「ウワサの 魚みたいな人たちは\n 海底の王国から あがってきたんだそうです。\: "Those fish-like people came up from an undersea kingdom, I hear. A kingdom beautiful as paradise.
tm.「いやあ～ 海の底に王国があったなんて\n たまげちゃいましたよ。\n まっこと: "I was stunned that a kingdom exists beneath the sea. The world really is wide!
tm.「取り引きの帰りに 町に立ち寄ったら\n ちょうど 魔物たちの襲撃に 巻き込まれ: "I stopped in town on my way back from a deal and got caught in the monster attack. I ran for my life.
tm.「なんとか お客さんに満足してもらえて\n ひと仕事終えて いい気分だったってい: "I'd just satisfied my customer and felt good about finishing the job, and then this. What a disaster.
tm.「あの情報屋から 聞きましたよ。\n あなたが この町を救ってくれたとか。: "I heard from that informant. You saved this town, they say.
tm.「これは まだ知らない人に 伝えておかないと。\n ダーハルーネを 救ってくれた: "I should tell those who don't know yet. The one who saved Gondolia is the Luminary, {var:1}!
tm.「町に 魔物が攻めてきたときも\n オイラぁ 酔っぱらっててな……。\n でも: "When monsters attacked the town I was drunk... But someone seems to have saved me.
tm.「こんな 飲んだくれなんざ\n 放っておいても よかったのによ。\n ……ありが: "You could've left a drunk like me alone. ...There are some grateful people out there.
tm.「ソルティコの町を出て ふと この町に\n 立ち寄ったときに よりにもよって\n: "I left Puerto Valor and stopped in this town, only to run into a monster attack of all times.
tm.「無事に済んだのは やはり商人のカンが……\n いや そもそもカンが はたらいて: "I got through thanks to a merchant's instinct... no, with such instinct I'd never have met the attack.
tm.「まさか 魔物が 町を襲ってくるなんて！\n のんびりなんてせずに 早く\n ソ: "Monsters attacking a town! I should've gone to Puerto Valor sooner instead of dawdling!
tm.「でも こうして無事に済んだわけですし\n もう少しくらいは ゆっくりしても\n: "But we're safe now, so surely it's fine to relax a bit longer.
tm.「今は こうして 静かに寝ていますが\n ちょっと前までは それはもうこわがって: "She's sleeping quietly now, but until recently she was so scared she couldn't sleep.
tm.「いーっぱい 魔物がおそってきて\n ホントに こわかったの……。\n ママにし: "So many monsters attacked, I was really scared... I clung to Mama and bawled.
tm.「優秀な船乗りの仲間たちは\n みーんな 海に出ていったきりで\n 帰ってこない: "My skilled sailor friends all went out to sea and haven't come back.
tm.「オイラみたいなノロマだけ 残っちゃうなんて\n 皮肉なモンだよ…… ううっ ヒ: "Only slowpokes like me remain... how ironic. Sob, hic.
tm.「航海に出てった 船乗りの仲間は\n いまだに 帰ってこないけれど……\n その: "My sailor friends who sailed out still haven't returned... but I believe they'll come back.
tm.「オイラは まだ船乗りとして未熟者だけど\n みんなが帰ってこない間は\n この: "I'm still a green sailor, but while everyone's away, I have to support this harbor!
tm.「今日も 仕事はキツかったけど\n 故郷の母ちゃんのために オイラ がんばるよ。: "Work was tough again today, but I'll do my best for my mother back home. I'll never give up!
tm.「魔物の襲撃があったせいで\n 荷積みのスケジュールが メチャクチャだぜ！: "The monster attack wrecked our loading schedule!
tm.「オラ 新入り！ サボってんじゃねぇぞ！\n そんなに チンタラ作業してたら\n: "Hey, rookie! Quit slacking! At this pace the sun'll set before we finish!
tm.「オレたち 船乗りの仕事は 身体が資本だ。\n よく飲んで よく食べて 体力をつ: "A sailor's body is his capital. Drink well, eat well, build stamina. Though I ate a bit too much...
tm.「町長のラハディオさんは 頼りになります。\n 今回も あの方が みんなを導いた: "Mayor Rotondo is reliable. His guidance this time kept the losses to a minimum.
tm.「もう デルカダールに にらまれることもないし\n ラハディオさんには これから: "Heliodor won't be glaring at us anymore, so I hope Mr. Rotondo stays mayor forever.
tm.「辛うじて生き残った 目撃者の証言によれば\n 魔王がつかわせた 海を支配する化: "A survivor says the Dark One sent a sea-ruling monster that surfaces and vanishes into the rain...
tm.「にわかには 信じられませんが……\n 広い海を手中に収める 化け物ですから\n: "Hard to believe, but a monster that holds the wide sea must have fearsome power.
tm.「海底からやってきた 魚のような方々……\n なぜ 地上でも ヘッチャラなのでし: "Those fish-like folks from the seabed... why are they fine on land? Did they originally live on land...?
tm.「私 不思議に思いましてね。身体を調べたいと\n 魚のような方々に お願いしたの: "I wondered and asked to examine their bodies, but they flatly refused. Sigh...
tm.「先日 現れた クラーゴンといい\n 今回の 凶暴化した魔物の軍団といい\n 世: "With the Kraken and now this violent monster army, the world's laws seem to have gone mad.
tm.「いくら 古い文献を調べても\n こんなことは 記録になかった！\n ああ……わ: "I've checked old records but none mention this! Ah... not understanding is terrifying!
tm.「オオオ……ホント こわかった。\n 魔物が 町に たくさん来て\n オレ 必死: "Ooh... that was really scary. Lots of monsters came to town and I ran for my life...
tm.「こうして のんびりしていられるのも\n 町を救ってくれた 勇者さまのおかげ……: "That I can relax like this is thanks to the Luminary who saved the town... I'm very grateful.
tm.「町が襲われたとき そこの彼が\n 私の手を引いて 一緒に逃げてくれたんです。: "When the town was attacked, that man took my hand and ran with me.
tm.「さすがは 元兵士だけのことはあって\n いざという時には 身体が勝手に動くんで: "As a former soldier, his body moves on its own in a crisis. He saved my life.
tm.「ここ最近の 世界の様子は\n まるで 麻のように乱れていて\n 気が休まるとき: "The world lately is tangled like hemp. I never get a moment's peace.
tm.「今回も 勇者さまのチカラで\n なんとか 魔物たちは退治されましたが\n 次に: "The Luminary's power got rid of the monsters again, but what happens next time...
tm.「……ムッ なんだい キミは？\n ボクはね……大樹が落ちた後 各地を旅して\n: "...Hm? Who are you? After Yggdrasil fell, I traveled around and saw the world's ruin with my own eyes!
tm.「その過程で 多くの悲しみを目撃してね……\n あの悲しみを 絵の中で表現するの: "Along the way I saw so much sorrow... Expressing it in paintings is my calling!
tm.「さあ わかっただろう？\n 仕事のジャマだ！ 出てった 出てった！: "Now you understand? You're disturbing my work! Out, out!
tm.「……ムッ なんだい キミは？\n 今 いいところなんだ。長い間 描いていた絵が: "...Hm? Who are you? I'm at a good part. The painting I've worked on for so long is almost done!
tm.「ボクはね……大樹が落ちた後 各地を旅して\n 世界が荒廃した様子を この目で見: "After Yggdrasil fell, I traveled around and saw the world's ruin with my own eyes. Now that painting will be finished!
tm.「……描ける！ 今なら描けるぞ！\n 芸術界を震撼させるような ボクの最高の画を: "...I can paint! I can paint now! I can send out my finest work to shake the art world!
tm.「名づけて 海都の勇者！\n ああっ！ この町を救ってくれた 勇者の姿を\n す: "I'll title it Hero of the Sea City! Ah! I want to carve the Luminary who saved this town onto the canvas right now!
tm.「……おいおい これからボクは\n さらに イメージを高めるために集中するんだ。: "...Hey, I'm about to concentrate to sharpen my image. You're a bother, go somewhere else!
tm.「おや こちらの家に 何かご用でしょうか。\n ここには 昔の財産を食いつぶして: "Oh, do you need something at this house? A painter lived here, living off his old fortune.
tm.「ですが…… 大樹が落ちた後 ご主人さまは\n 荒廃した世界を ありのままに描く: "But after Yggdrasil fell, he believed painting the ruined world as it is was his duty and set out.
tm.「いつ 帰ってくるかは ぞんじあげませんが……\n ご主人さまが 帰ってくるまで: "I don't know when he'll return, but I'll keep guarding this house until he does.
tm.「あら お客さま。\n 旅に出ていた ご主人さまが帰られまして……\n 私 とっ: "Oh, a visitor. The master who went traveling has returned... I'm so happy.
tm.「……別に ご主人さまが無事に帰ってきて\n うれしいというワケでは ありません: "...Not that I'm happy he's safe. Without an employer, there's no pay.
tm.「あら お客さま。ご主人さまが\n 長い間 取りかかっていらっしゃる絵が\n よ: "Oh, a visitor. The painting the master has long worked on is finally nearly done.
